description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter is applicable only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh:
列表排序方式。取值：

- **asc**：正序。

- **desc**：倒序。
description.en:
The sort order of the list. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending order.

- **desc**: descending order.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为**1**。
description.en: The page number when using paging. Sets the current page number. Default value: **1**.
The number of entries per page. Default value: **10**.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC) in seconds.

title.zh: 查询API安全风险域名统计数据
title.en: Query API security risk domain name statistics
